settings.text: 2. Most Snoring Starts with an Open Mouth
Alex wearing Hostage Tape in bed beside his wife

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Your mouth stays open all night. That dr
settings.text: Your mouth stays open all night. That dries you out, cuts deep sleep, and leaves you foggy even after 7–8 hours. Hostage Tape is a soft fabric strip that keeps your mouth closed so you breathe through your nose instead. Most men have never tried mouth tape. This is the simple version that stays on and lets you breathe.
